module: Tooltip preview of the Flowgraph editor: displays, in a small dedicated node editor (200x200), a library node, a macro or a hovered graph. It creates its own editor context, instantiates the node in a dummy graph ("nodePreview") or redraws the nodes and links of the graph, frames the content, then displays the name (and path) under the preview.
notes: The mode (node, macro, graph) is chosen by setNode / setMacro / setGraph; draw only draws for the node and graph modes (the macro mode is not drawn).
In graph mode, the position of each node is read from the main editor (self.fgEditor.ectx) then copied into the preview.
An error while drawing a node is caught (xpcall) and flagged as a node error.

attach.desc: Associates the manager and creates the dummy 'nodePreview' graph.

init.desc: Initializes the state (hover, "node" mode, preview size 200x200).

setNode.desc: Sets the hovered element as a library node (node mode).

setMacro.desc: Sets the hovered element as a macro (macro mode).

setGraph.desc: Sets the hovered element as a graph (graph mode).

draw.desc: Draws the preview tooltip if an element is hovered, saving/restoring the current editor.
